whatsNew_1_3_1.message:
The folder sidebar works again after WhatsApp's latest update.
Folders are now found even when WhatsApp renames its filter bar.

whatsNew_1_3_2.message:
On Windows and Linux, privacy mode is now Alt+Shift+P and Refined settings Alt+Shift+Comma.
WhatsApp's own Ctrl+Alt+P (Profile) and Ctrl+Alt+Comma (Settings) work again.

whatsNew_1_4_0.message:
Pin as many chats as you like above the chat list, and drag them into any order.
Remind me snoozes a chat; it comes back in the Snoozed list when it is due.
Cmd/Ctrl+K opens Refined's command palette; add Shift for WhatsApp's own search.
Chats that @mention you gather under Mentions.
WhatsApp Business labels show in the folder rail in their own colours.

whatsNew_1_5_0.message:
Remind me times are yours to set: add ones like 3 minutes or 3 days in settings, and keep up to five.
A due reminder now shows a card on WhatsApp, and system notifications stay on screen with Open chat and Snooze buttons.
Send a test notification from settings to check that alerts reach you.
The command palette is part of Shortcuts now; its keys are listed there.
Release notes for every version are under Settings.
Reset keeps a backup of your settings, so you can restore them in one click.
